status.scope: Unique explicit concrete display IDs in vanilla data/json for eight renderable categories plus runtime IDs from upstream CPP_IDS and required lighting/fallback IDs. Mods, derived vehicle variants, field intensities, overmap rotation/line suffixes, corpses, equipment/mutation overlays, seasonal/variant IDs, effects and runtime generated IDs are not included in this denominator. Static source candidates, including possible obsolete/pseudo definitions; not active runtime total.
status.game_integration: Optional core and overmap standard tile configs include all 19847 explicit static candidates; WASM preload and engine test pending with main owner. No engine build/settings change.

alias_rules.terrain_furniture: mapdata.cpp 1010-1013 copy-from sets looks_like, explicit looks_like overrides
alias_rules.item: item_factory.cpp 4198-4206: concrete copy-from becomes looks_like; abstract inheritance retains parent looks_like; explicit override wins
alias_rules.monster: monstergenerator.cpp 786-789: inherited nonempty looks_like retained; otherwise copy-from; explicit override wins
alias_rules.overmap: overmap.cpp 918-928: explicit list overrides; otherwise prepend copy-from to inherited looks_like
alias_rules.ambiguity: Any multiple source definitions differing in content are left unresolved; not assumed active runtime load order.
